title: Dasht-e-bala mein sarwar basti basa rahe hain
body:
dasht-e-bala mein sarwar basti basa rahe hain
yasrab ke rahne wale aansoo baha rahe hain
1. ubhra hassan ke qath se har ek lafz-e-ulfat
tahreer pao ke moula aansoo baha rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
2. sarvar se keh rahe hain shahed se bhi shiri
kya maut ka mazaa hain qasim bata rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
3. jis naazni ko sarwar dulha bana chuke kal
us naazni ki mayyat sarwar utha rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
4. kohram ek barpa hai ehle haram mein harsoo
dulha ki laash rakhney masnad bicha rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
5. farwa dulhan ko zainab laashe pe leke boli
sehrey ke phool sabko phir khoon rula rahe hain
